pages.title: Mouse trap
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Free trapped mice in Mouse trap by tapping groups of three or more blocks. Clear the pieces around each mouse and look for groups that open up more of the board in one move. Use rewards during the level to remove extra blocks when you need room.

pages.title: Movie Night Glam Dress Up
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Put together a cinema-night look in Movie Night Glam Dress Up. Choose clothes, then try hairstyles and makeup that suit the outfit. Finish with accessories or change the palette to give the evening a different style.

pages.title: Connect Clues - The Missing Professor
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Drop clues into the evidence pile in Connect Clues - The Missing Professor. Move each clue sideways before releasing it so it can land on one of the same kind. Two matching clues merge into a new one. Open the investigation log to follow Inspector Hale and Detective Crane's search for Professor Eldridge.

pages.title: OUTSIDE
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Guide a one-eyed character to the key and exit in OUTSIDE. Once you pick a direction, the character slides until a wall stops it. Work out which wall can give you the next useful stopping point, then plan the turns that bring you to the key and door.

pages.title: Hazel Tangle Rope 3D: Sorting Puzzle
pages.creator: dotplay gmbh
pages.description: Move the ends of colorful ropes in Hazel Tangle Rope 3D: Sorting Puzzle. Look at which strands cross above or below one another before deciding where an endpoint should go. Untangle the ropes and sort them by color as the layouts get more complicated.

pages.title: Lollipop Stack Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gather lollipops while running through Lollipop Stack Run. Steer toward the sweets to make your stack taller, then find a gap through the obstacles so you can keep collecting. Look ahead and move early when the next batch is on the other side of the course.

pages.title: Draw War
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Draw a force and send it into battle in Draw War. Use the numbers to see how many soldiers your formation summons, then choose between shielded troops, mounted soldiers, and beasts. Change your lineup as the fight calls for different units.

pages.title: Bunnys Farm
pages.creator: Supercode Games
pages.description: Travel with Bunny through meadows, snowy peaks, and other landscapes in Bunnys Farm. Match fruits such as oranges and peaches in groups of three to solve the boards. Clear more puzzles to follow the story and open its next chapter.

pages.title: Paper.io 2
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Claim territory by drawing loops in Paper.io 2. Leave your colored area, trace a route, and return to it to capture the space inside. Rivals can eliminate you by crossing your exposed trail, so check where they are before you venture far from your color.

pages.title: Block Eating Simulator
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Eat scattered blocks to grow in Block Eating Simulator. Once your cube has enough points, you can take on smaller opponents as well. Watch for bigger cubes while you climb the leaderboard, and try a solo round or play with a second player.

pages.title: CraftsMan 3D Gangster
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Explore a block-built city in CraftsMan 3D Gangster. Rival criminals are looking for you, so watch for trouble while moving through the streets. Fight your way through the levels as the city sends more dangerous opponents after you.

pages.title: Dynamons 8
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Explore a festival world and a bonus cave in Dynamons 8. Recruit creatures such as Robocanyx or Jaxaguar and train a team for one-on-one battles. Use special attacks and power-ups, and follow Jovani's guidance as you learn what each Dynamon can do.

pages.title: Dreamy Jewel
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Line up matching gems in Dreamy Jewel to clear them horizontally or vertically. A match of four or more creates a special piece. Bring special pieces together to combine their effects and clear a larger part of the board.

pages.title: Poke The Presidents
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Throw objects at cartoon politicians in Poke The Presidents and watch their exaggerated reactions. Try a different weapon to change what happens when it hits. Use the money you earn to buy more items from the shop.

pages.title: Falling Party
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Read the picture on the screen in Falling Party and race to a floor tile showing the same image. A wrong tile can cost you the round, and rivals can shove you out of the way. Reach the right spot and try to be the last player standing.

pages.title: Vehicle Parking Master 3D
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Line up vehicles with marked bays in Vehicle Parking Master 3D. Try the challenge and parking stages and handle trucks as the layouts get harder. Finish the available sets of levels to open the secret mode.

pages.title: Jingle Juggle Merge
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Drop holiday ornaments into the pile in Jingle Juggle Merge. Matching ornaments combine when they meet, leaving a bigger one behind. Look for a spot where the next orb can reach its partner without taking up space you will need for later drops.

pages.title: Build a Snowman
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Move two snowman pieces at once in Build a Snowman. The same move affects both halves, so use walls and blocked paths to bring them together. Watch for traps while working out which direction can bring the halves closer without putting one in danger.

pages.title: Granny Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Assemble nine horror-themed pictures in Granny Jigsaw Puzzle. Pick an image and choose a layout with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Look for details that carry across the edges of the pieces and try to finish the picture quickly.

pages.title: Zakantosh Cardgame Lite
pages.creator: ChrioGames
pages.description: Build a collection of cards and gems in Zakantosh Cardgame Lite. Use them in single-player battles against creatures driven by mysterious crystals. Follow the story to see what is behind the attacks and adjust your deck as you find new cards.

pages.title: Girls Nail Salon
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Design a manicure in Girls Nail Salon. Use the mouse or touch controls to decorate the nails and try different styles together. Repeat a design across the set or give individual nails their own details.

pages.title: Weird Dance on Wednesday
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Help Rogue prepare for her school dance in Weird Dance on Wednesday. Pair the black dress with bold eye and lip makeup, and add freckles if they suit the look. Finish the styling before she takes her rehearsed dance to the floor.

pages.title: Planet Explorer Addition
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Choose the addition expression with a different result in Planet Explorer Addition. Work out the totals of all four choices and pick the one that does not match. A correct answer takes you to another planet as you continue exploring for gems.

pages.title: World Cup Fever
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Lead a three-player squad in World Cup Fever. Swipe a player in the direction you want them to move and use the team to get the ball toward the other goal. Win matches as you work toward the World Cup title.

pages.title: Blondy in Pink
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Give Blondy a pink-themed makeover in Blondy in Pink. Start with facial care, then choose makeup, a hairstyle, and jewelry. Finish with an outfit and accessories that bring the colors together.

pages.title: Merge Block Raising
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Play numbered cards from your hand onto the board in Merge Block Raising. When at least three adjacent cards share a value, they merge into a card one number higher and you earn another card to play. Keep making merges, since running out of cards in your hand ends the game.

pages.title: Nend.io
pages.creator: LapaMauve
pages.description: Find a way to make a living in Nend.io. Work on computers, clean up, or buy buildings that earn commissions when other players use them. Spend your money on housing and upgrades, and arrange for a successor before your character grows old.

pages.title: Among Mahjong Tiles
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Match pairs of symbols in Among Mahjong Tiles before time runs out. A tile needs an open left or right edge before you can select it. Use a hint or shuffle when the remaining matches are hard to find, then clear the rest of the layout.

pages.title: 4X4 Off Road Rally 3D
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive one of four rally vehicles in 4X4 Off Road Rally 3D. Reach the marked finish before time expires and steer carefully near the river, since falling in ends the attempt. Work through ten courses with different approaches to the finish.

pages.title: Firebug
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Run across platforms that catch fire when you touch them in Firebug. Keep moving toward the exit before the route burns away. Pick up jellybeans for a bonus and spend them on hats and other extras.

pages.title: Santa Chase
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Steer Santa through snowy missions in Santa Chase and collect gifts to make his train longer. Keep clear of the pursuing police while watching where the train follows you. Turn with the left and right controls as you work toward each mission's goal.

pages.title: Extra Hot Chili 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Take on spicy-food challenges in Extra Hot Chili 3D. Use clicks or taps to handle each task and see how the game works through different levels of heat. Pay attention to the food in front of you as the challenges change.

pages.title: Traffic Arrow
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Tap where you want the blue arrow to go in Traffic Arrow. Grey arrows come from different directions, so look for a gap before moving. Keep weaving through the traffic for as long as you can without a collision.

pages.title: Filled Glass 3 Portals
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fill the glass to its dotted line in Filled Glass 3 Portals. Release colored balls and work out how the portals redirect them. Look at where the balls emerge before releasing more so the container reaches the marked level.

pages.title: Hardest Game Ever
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Guide a red square past moving blue circles in Hardest Game Ever. Collect every yellow circle before heading to the green area. Plan when to cross each danger zone as you work through 60 levels.

pages.title: Funny Shapes
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Fit each shape into its matching outline in Funny Shapes. Look at the corners and curves to decide which frame it belongs in. Move the pieces into place one at a time until every shape has found its frame.

pages.title: Jelly Cubes
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Place and rotate sets of jelly cubes in Jelly Cubes. Make groups of three matching colors to remove them and score, or build a larger group for more points. The game has no timer, so check what space each placement leaves before adding the next set.

pages.title: Space Pic Puzzler
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Swap neighboring pieces to rebuild a space picture in Space Pic Puzzler. Move pieces horizontally or vertically and follow details that continue across their edges. Your score falls as time passes, so try to finish the image with as few wasted swaps as possible.

pages.title: Merge Mahjong
pages.creator: Fish Pond Studio
pages.description: Work through handmade tile puzzles in Merge Mahjong. Combine pieces to make space for later moves and check what the board leaves you after a merge. Earn boosters and use them when the current layout is difficult to solve.

pages.title: Dead Zed (No Blood)
pages.creator: 3KG
pages.description: Shoot approaching zombies and manage a group of survivors in Dead Zed (No Blood). Assign people to defend or repair the safehouse, or send a search party to find weapons and survivors. Consider each person's skills when deciding who should go out and who should stay behind.

pages.title: Fall Boys Ultimate Knockout
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Grab opponents and throw them off the platform in Fall Boys Ultimate Knockout. Carry a rival to the edge while watching for other players trying to grab you. Each successful throw makes you a little bigger as you fight to be the last one left.

pages.title: Cute Teddy Bears Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild three teddy bear pictures in Cute Teddy Bears Slide. Choose a three-by-three, four-by-four, or five-by-five board, then slide the pieces into the right places. Look for details that continue from one tile to the next.

pages.title: Ludo Wizard
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Roll a die and move your tokens toward the center in Ludo Wizard. Choose which token to advance on each turn. Play against the computer, join an online opponent, or use a private code to invite friends.

pages.title: Cruise Ships Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Find pairs of ship pictures in Cruise Ships Memory. Flip two tiles and remember where each picture appeared if they differ. Clear the pairs across four levels and see whether you can do it in fewer moves.

pages.title: Endless Spinning
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Shoot balls into a moving line in Endless Spinning. Make groups of three matching colors to remove them before the line reaches the hole. Aim where the next ball can join a useful group as the chain keeps moving.

pages.title: Beeline
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Fly over small flowers in Beeline to make them bloom, then return to base. Watch where the flies are as you steer toward the next flower. Use the mouse or drag on a touch screen to take a route that avoids them.

pages.title: Wild Bear Hunting Game
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Track wild animals in Wild Bear Hunting Game. Use the arrow keys to move your hunter and watch for animals that may attack when you approach. Line up your shots as you work through hunting quests across jungle and savanna settings.

pages.title: Pong Soccer
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Send a football past your opponent and into the goal in Pong Soccer. Move with the arrow keys or touch controls to intercept the ball and send it back. Start on Normal or try Hard when you want a tougher opponent.

pages.title: Animal Dash and Jump
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Choose an animal and time your moves in Animal Dash and Jump. Watch for obstacles as the character speeds through one of three tracks. There are 48 characters to choose from as you try to make it to the finish.

pages.title: Twist Ball Rotator
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Jump left or right in Twist Ball Rotator. Tap the corresponding side of the screen or use the arrow keys to choose a direction. Read what is ahead and time the next jump as you try to raise your score.

pages.title: Easter Memory Game
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Turn over Easter-themed tiles in Easter Memory Game and find the matching pairs. Remember the position of each picture when your first two picks differ. Clear all the tiles and try to do it in fewer turns on another attempt.

pages.title: Old SUV Car Parking Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Drive an SUV into a parking bay in Old SUV Car Parking Game. Give the vehicle room to turn before lining it up with the marked space. Work through the levels by judging how much clearance you have around the car as you park.

pages.title: Easter Patterns
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find the missing item in each sequence in Easter Patterns. Look at what repeats, then drag the right item into the blank. See how many patterns you can finish in three minutes.

pages.title: Stickman Adventures
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Run toward the castle in Stickman Adventures. Use the arrow keys or on-screen buttons to move and jump past mechanical traps. Time each jump so you clear the hazard and still have room to land before the next one.

pages.title: City Ball Dunkin
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guide a basketball through each hoop in City Ball Dunkin. Keep it away from the ceiling and the ground while you time your approach to moving baskets. Earn points for new balls as the hoops get harder to reach.

pages.title: Seashore Treasure
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Pick up a different beach item on every turn in Seashore Treasure. Remember whether you already tapped a shell, turtle, sunshade, or another object before selecting it again. Try the memory challenge across three beaches and see how far you can extend the sequence.

pages.title: Stack Jump
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Jump onto moving blocks in Stack Jump. Wait until the next block is close enough to land on, then jump and let it become part of the stack. Keep timing the jumps as you build toward the summit.

pages.title: Hero Stunt Spider Bike Simulator 3d 2
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Take on rescue and stunt missions in Hero Stunt Spider Bike Simulator 3d 2. Ride a motorcycle to collect checkpoints, help people, and chase a helicopter. Pick a bike and work through the different objectives as the city changes around you.

pages.title: Make Your Little Kids
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Create a character in Make Your Little Kids by dragging body parts into place. Choose the boy's hairstyle and clothes to change his appearance. Try different combinations and move pieces around until you have the look you want.

pages.title: Stickman Sniper 3
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Read the mission brief before firing in Stickman Sniper 3. Work out which targets you need to hit and use the scene to find a clear shot. Take out the required targets to finish the level and move on to another assignment.

pages.title: Amazing Bubble Connect
pages.creator: Amazing Games Network
pages.description: Link bubbles of the same color in Amazing Bubble Connect. A line or square of four can earn extra points, while linking five creates a wild bubble. Watch for ticking bombs and clear them before they end the round.

pages.title: Traffic Go
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Make your way across busy streets in Traffic Go. Watch the cars in each lane and wait for a gap before crossing. Keep checking traffic as you work toward the goal without a collision.

pages.title: Spartan Bouncing Ball
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Defend Sparta from Persian troops in Spartan Bouncing Ball. Use the ball's rebounds to keep hitting the advancing forces. Watch where it returns and set up the next bounce before the enemies make it through.

pages.title: Zombie Shooter
pages.creator: BRAVO
pages.description: Take out zombies with a limited supply of shots in Zombie Shooter. Look at the positions of the targets before firing and choose a line that makes each bullet count. Clear the group before you run out of ammunition.

pages.title: Cubeyflap
pages.creator: Ricreator
pages.description: Guide a small cube from one patch of ground to the next in Cubeyflap. Pick up hearts along the way and keep the cube from falling into the water. Watch where the next safe landing is before moving again.

pages.title: Crash Day Demolition Dubai Arena
pages.creator: Smartline-Games
pages.description: Crash into rivals in Crash Day Demolition Dubai Arena. The arena sits near an airport, with other drivers trying to wreck your car before you wreck theirs. Give yourself room to build up speed before lining up a hit.

pages.title: Ultimate Ninja Swing
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Swing on an extendable rope in Ultimate Ninja Swing. Avoid sharp edges, shurikens, and chainsaws as you move from point to point. Use the tutorial to learn the controls, then time your swings through the levels to reach the finish in one piece.

pages.title: Crazy Shooters 2
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Create a lobby or join one in Crazy Shooters 2. Fight other players in a multiplayer match and watch where rivals approach as you move through the map. Set up a lobby when you want to bring friends into the same game.

pages.title: Police Stunt Cars
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take one of ten police vehicles onto stunt maps in Police Stunt Cars. Drive at speed, drift around turns, and hit the ramps to get airborne. Try a different map or take the police limousine out when you want a change of vehicle.

pages.title: Earth Invaders
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Defend Earth against incoming attackers in Earth Invaders. Watch where the invaders are moving and line up shots as they come into range. Work through five levels without a time limit.

pages.title: Hot Rod Cars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Assemble pictures of custom cars in Hot Rod Cars. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard before putting the pieces together. There is no timer, so you can use the wheels, bodywork, and background to work out how the pieces fit at your own pace.

pages.title: Barrier
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Steer a formula car around barriers in Barrier. The car speeds up as the run continues, giving you less time to move before an obstacle. Watch for the next opening and see how long you can keep the car on its way.

pages.title: Brick Breaker
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Bounce a ball into candy-colored bricks in Brick Breaker. Keep the ball in play and aim its rebounds toward the bricks that are still standing. Clear the entire layout to move from the early stages to more difficult boards.

pages.title: Particolo
pages.creator: Roman Parada
pages.description: Turn the whole layout a single color in Particolo. Choose colors that bring more of the board together with each move. Look at which areas the current color touches before making a change so you can reach the remaining patches.

pages.title: Princess Fashion Competition
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style five princesses in Princess Fashion Competition as they compete for places in the finals. Choose an outfit for each contestant and compare how the different looks come together. Pick the clothes you want each princess to wear in front of the judges.

pages.title: Strike Combat Pixel Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Fight on block-built maps in Strike Combat Pixel Multiplayer. Pick a region and join a lobby for cooperative play or free-for-all battles against players and zombies. Create a lobby with your preferred map and weapon when you want to set up a match yourself.

pages.title: Cartoon Car Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Choose from three car illustrations in Cartoon Car Jigsaw. Put one together with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces, depending on how much detail you want to work through. Use the car's outline and nearby colors to find pieces that fit.

pages.title: Cowboys vs Robots
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Use a cowboy's pistol to stop a robot invasion in Cowboys vs Robots. Aim at the attackers before they close in and work through increasingly difficult levels. Play for a higher score and try to earn all the stars.

pages.title: Viking
pages.creator: Genetic Studio
pages.description: Face another fighter in a one-on-one duel in Viking. Choose Battle to take on a friend or Single to fight the computer. Watch your opponent's position as you look for an opening and try to win the duel.

pages.title: Most Wanted
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Create a wanted-poster portrait in Most Wanted. Click the controls to change the hair, eyes, eyebrows, and other facial features. Add details such as a mask, glasses, or a tattoo, then choose a frame for the finished portrait.

pages.title: Talking Tom Christmas Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Get Tom ready for Christmas in Talking Tom Christmas Time. Choose how he should look for the holiday, then help him decorate the Christmas tree. Try different combinations as you put together Tom's festive scene.

pages.title: Bubble Spin
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Clear a rotating group of bubbles in Bubble Spin. Watch the angle of the cluster as you aim, then send your bubble toward a matching group. Work around the cluster until you have removed every bubble.

pages.title: SLIDING BOX
pages.creator: super game web
pages.description: Slide the box through the course in SLIDING BOX. Choose Easy, Normal, or Hard and work toward the end of the selected challenge. The game lets you save and load your progress if you want to return to the course later.

pages.title: Sprout Hair Pins
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Design a look around floral accessories in Sprout Hair Pins. Start by customizing the doll's face, including her brows, eyes, nose, and lips. Add a sprout-style hairpin to see how the plant-inspired accessory changes the finished look.

pages.title: Operate Now: Pericardium Surgery
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help a young patient with chest pain in Operate Now: Pericardium Surgery. Follow the instructions in the operating room and use the required instruments as the procedure progresses. Check what the game asks for before moving to the next step.

pages.title: Hocus Froggus
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Follow a witch's lessons in Hocus Froggus and use the mouse to try her spells. Watch what happens after each spell and explore the magical scene as new actions become available. Work through the activities to see what the witch can do.

pages.title: Supermarket Manager
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Choose uniforms for three employees in Supermarket Manager. Pick an outfit for each worker, then add shoes and accessories that go with it. Give the staff a coordinated style or try a different look for each employee.
